verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a dedicated REST API covering core accounting data—transactions, categories, statements, merchants, treasury, plus a full Accounts Receivable API (customers, invoices, webhooks)—with both read and write operations (create/edit/delete categories, update transaction metadata, create/cancel invoices). This was independently corroborated by a live probe of Mercury's official CLI, which exposed a full resource command tree (accounts, transactions, categories, invoices, customers, payments, etc.) matching the docs.
